items.title: Park Bo-gum named Gucci global brand ambassador
items.summary: Gucci officially appointed Korean actor Park Bo-gum as its new global brand ambassador, citing his boldness in new roles and nuanced performances as matching the house's aesthetic vision. Park said he looks forward to understanding creative director Demna's style language and adding his own aesthetic on top of it.

items.title: 박보검, '구찌' 글로벌 브랜드 앰버서더 발탁
items.summary: Korean entertainment press coverage of the Park Bo-gum Gucci ambassador announcement, noting his joining various brand activities and quoting his comment about being happy and excited about the role.

items.title: 구찌, 새로운 글로벌 브랜드 앰버서더에 배우 박보검 선정
items.summary: Fashion trade coverage of the ambassador news, framing Park Bo-gum's casting as part of Gucci's push to build cultural relevance in the Korean market under creative director Demna.

items.title: 【公式発表】パクボゴム、グッチのグローバルアンバサダーに就任！
items.summary: Japanese fan-community blog relaying the official Park Bo-gum Gucci ambassador announcement and compiling Park's own social posts reacting to the news, indicating cross-border fan enthusiasm in Japan.

items.title: 「パクボゴムに、グッチを着て『世紀の悪役』を演じてほしい」ファッション業界の関係者投稿が話題
items.summary: Japanese fan blog amplifying a fashion-industry insider's social post wishing to see Park Bo-gum play a dramatic character styled by Gucci, illustrating organic SNS buzz around the ambassador news beyond official channels.

items.title: 더쿠 - 오늘 LA구찌행사장 박보검 (관련 스레드 재부상)
items.summary: Korean community thread on theqoo discussing Park Bo-gum's Gucci-related appearances, resurfacing amid the fresh ambassador announcement; comments mix excitement about the brand fit with nostalgia referencing his earlier Gucci event attendance.

items.title: ケリング株が一時16％超の急落、第3四半期の「グッチ」の売上低迷と再建への不透明感
items.summary: Kering shares fell over 16% after Q3 2026 results showed Gucci revenue down 6% comparable to EUR 1.291 billion, with directly operated retail revenue down 9% hurt by weak traffic in Asia Pacific, mainland China and Japan; CEO Luca de Meo called the Gucci turnaround the group's defining multi-season priority.

items.title: ケリングが年内に世界で100店舗を閉店 各ブランドの計画含む再建案「リコンケリング」を発表
items.summary: Kering announced its 'Reconquering' restructuring plan including at least 125 net global store closures in 2026 (128 closures vs 23 openings through nine months), with Gucci among the brands most affected as the group tries to stabilize margins amid continued sales pressure.

items.title: 구찌의 몰락, 수백억 달러 브랜드의 정체성 상실
items.summary: Long-form Korean business-magazine analysis of Gucci's decline citing Interbrand's 2025 Best Global Brands ranking, in which Gucci posted the steepest value drop of any luxury house (-35% YoY to $11.6B), attributed to lost creative direction, failed design transitions, and executive churn.

items.title: "84곳 문 닫았다"…매장 줄이는 명품 브랜드의 속내
items.summary: Korean business press reporting that Gucci closed roughly 84 stores (36 full-price plus outlet locations) as part of a plan to shutter about 125 stores by 2030, reorganizing product lineups and internal structure to restore profitability amid falling Korean luxury demand.

items.title: 잘 나가던 명품 '주춤'…가격 인상 피로감에 소비 열기 식나
items.summary: Korean daily reports that repeated luxury price hikes, including Gucci's, are producing consumer fatigue; cites EU antitrust fines against Gucci, Chloe and Loewe for resale-price-maintenance practices and a cooling Korean luxury consumption trend into year-end.

items.title: 「グッチ ビューティ」が新パウダーを発売 色補正効果とツヤ感が叶う
items.summary: Gucci Beauty (now L'Oreal-licensed) will launch the Glow Color Finishing Powder in three shades (JPY 9,570) on Jan 13, 2027 in Japan, promising color-correcting and natural-glow finish, continuing the brand's post-beauty-sale product cadence.

items.source: Madame Figaro Japon / Yahoo! News Japan
items.title: グッチの新型バッグ「グッチ NY トートバッグ」が登場！伊勢丹新宿店でポップアップを開催
items.summary: Syndication of the GucciCore 2027 Cruise NY Tote launch and Isetan Shinjuku pop-up (Nov 4-10), carried on Yahoo News Japan's high-reach portal, extending the story's visibility beyond the fashion trade press.

items.title: Everyone in China recognizes Gucci. That's the problem
items.summary: Jing Daily argues that Gucci's 15-year China strategy of pure brand recognition has become a liability now that recognition without renewed meaning fails to drive purchases; Q3 2026 directly operated store sales in China fell as traffic weakened, pressuring Demna's repositioning efforts.

items.title: Gucci sells 'Made in China' sneakers for 1st time
items.summary: Gucci broke with its Italian-manufacturing tradition to sell its first China-made sneakers (RMB 7,050) and a matching leather slip-on, a symbolic shift being tracked in China as both a localization move and a heritage-dilution risk flagged by critics.

items.title: 古驰2026年怎么了？Demna首秀、降价40%、美妆易主三个维度说清
items.summary: Weibo explainer-style post summarizing Gucci's 2026 upheaval for Chinese consumers across three axes: Demna's debut, price cuts up to 40% narrowing the China-Europe gap, and the L'Oreal beauty-license handover; comment threads split between hope for a turnaround and skepticism about losing heritage appeal.

items.title: 古驰保值吗？2026年真实回收数据：最高72%的只有这3款
items.summary: Weibo secondhand/resale-focused post citing 2026 recycling-market data showing only three Gucci styles hold up to 72% resale value, while implying most other models have weaker resale retention, a direct read on secondary-market sentiment toward the brand.

items.title: 古驰2026年惊天巨变：Demna首秀、关店100家、中国降价40%，是重生还是豪赌？
items.summary: Weibo post framing Gucci's 2026 changes (Demna's debut, ~100 store closures, 40% China price cuts) as an open question of rebirth versus gamble, reflecting mixed-to-skeptical Chinese social sentiment about the brand's turnaround odds.

items.title: 구찌 시계 장단점(인증)
items.summary: Korean watch-enthusiast forum thread weighing pros and cons of owning a Gucci watch; a mid-tier community discussion reflecting ordinary-consumer product sentiment rather than brand-campaign buzz. Exact post date not shown on page; retained as an active community thread still surfacing in current searches.

items.title: 군대 슬리퍼 뺨치는 구찌 슬리퍼 퀄리티
items.summary: Korean men's-fashion forum post criticizing the perceived build quality of Gucci slide sandals, comparing them unfavorably to military-issue slippers; an example of quality-complaint chatter in community channels. Exact post date not shown on page.

items.title: 뎀나의 첫 26FW, 구찌를 다시 욕망하게 하다
items.summary: Korean fashion-media review praising Demna's debut 26FW Gucci collection as successfully stabilizing the business, reclaiming creative authority, and reinterpreting heritage, representing the more positive end of critical reaction to the new creative direction.

items.title: 뎀나가 구찌의 엔진에 시동을 걸었다
items.summary: Vogue Korea feature on Demna's creative restart at Gucci, discussing how his design language is being read by Korean fashion press as reviving brand momentum after a prolonged slump.

items.title: 머라이어 캐리가 여는 구찌의 마법 같은 홀리데이
items.summary: Korean fashion trade coverage of the Gucci x Mariah Carey holiday gift campaign featuring the Butterfly Special Collection, directed with a playful, bold house aesthetic for the 2026 holiday season, available online from Nov 2 and in select stores from mid-November.

items.title: ケリング株が一時16％超の急落、第3四半期の「グッチ」の売上低迷と再建への不透明感
items.summary: Yahoo Japan syndication of the Kering stock-plunge story, extending reach of the Gucci sales-decline/turnaround-uncertainty narrative to Yahoo's mass Japanese news audience; comments sections on Yahoo News typically skew critical of struggling megabrands.

items.title: 구찌, 새로운 글로벌 브랜드 앰버서더에 배우 박보검 선정
items.summary: Additional Korean trade-press pickup of the Park Bo-gum ambassador announcement, reinforcing the news cycle's dominant theme for the region this week.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀、关店105家、业绩承压，3个维度说清
items.summary: Weibo explainer post summarizing Gucci's debut show, 105 store closures, and continued earnings pressure for Chinese readers; representative of the dominant 'cautious/skeptical' framing of Gucci news circulating on Chinese social media this period.
